#from	input	to	output

# AZIK extended romaji for y2skk — generated from the current base table plus
# the AZIK rule set (per uim's japanese-azik.scm), adapted for SKK:
#
# AZIK suffix keys (2nd stroke), regular pattern for every consonant row:
#   z=〜あん  k=〜いん  j=〜うん  d=〜えん  l=〜おん   (vowel-key row below)
#   q=〜あい  h=〜うう  w=〜えい  p=〜おう             (double vowels)
# Other AZIK changes: `;`=っ, `:`=ー, c row=ちゃ行, x row=しゃ行,
# `g` replaces `y` in 拗音 (kga=きゃ), plus frequent-word shortcuts (kt=こと …).
#
# SKK adaptations (deviations from stock AZIK):
#   - ん is on `[` (US) / `@` (JP); bare `q` is the kana toggle in SKK
#   - `tt` stays っ so okurigana like omoTte works (uim tt=たち not adopted)
#   - `nd` is not defined so okurigana like yoNde stays ん+で (uim nd=ねん not adopted)
#   - small ぁぃぅぇぉ/ゎ/ゐ/ゑ are on `xx` prefix; ゃゅょ=xy*, ゕゖ=xk*/xc*, っ=xtu
#   - arrows moved from zh/zj/zk/zl to xxh/xxj/xxk/xxl
#   - uim's l-prefix rules are omitted (l = ASCII mode)
	a		あ
	i		い
	u		う
	e		え
	o		お

# AZIK single keys
	;		っ
	:		ー
